species.name: Gag Grouper
species.quote: It shall be unlawful to possess black grouper or gag grouper less than 24 inches total length. ... It shall be unlawful to possess gag grouper except from 12:01 A.M. on May 1, 2026 through 11:59 P.M. on August 1,2026, subject to the bag and vessel limits in Section XVII. B
species.limit: 1 per person per day (gag or black grouper, not both); 2 gag/black grouper combined per private vessel per day; 2 per for-hire vessel per trip
species.notes: Captain and crew on a for-hire vessel with a Federal or For-Hire Snapper-Grouper Permit may not retain gag or black grouper. Within the 3-fish grouper/tilefish aggregate.

zones.label: NC coastal waters (to 3 mi)
zones.bagNote: 1 per person per day (gag or black grouper, not both); 2 gag/black combined per private vessel per day; for-hire 2 per vessel per trip

zones.label: Federal waters (3–200 mi, SAFMC)
zones.bagNote: 1 per person per day (gag or black grouper, not both); 2 gag/black combined per private vessel per day; for-hire 2 per vessel per trip

userNotes: 2026 gag season ran May 1 – Aug 1, 2026; it is closed now. The general shallow-water grouper window is May 1 – Dec 31 but gag has its own shorter season set by proclamation.
Only one gag OR one black grouper per person, and no more than two gag/black combined on a private boat per day (two per trip on a charter/headboat).
For-hire captains and crew may not keep gag or black grouper.

Counts toward the 3-fish grouper/tilefish aggregate per person per day (gag, black, snowy, misty, red, rock hind, red hind, coney, graysby, yellowedge, yellowfin, scamp, yellowmouth, blueline tilefish, golden tilefish, sand tilefish).

Snapper-grouper gear rules: non-offset, non-stainless circle hooks with natural bait; a dehooking tool and a descending device (16 oz weight, 60 ft line) must be on board; fish must be landed with heads and fins intact.
Federal rules apply in both state and SAFMC waters; seasons can close early when catch limits are met — check safmc.net/regulations.

issues: files.nc.gov (DMF proclamation PDFs) is blocked by the agent proxy for curl and for in-browser fetch (CORS); PDFs were read through WebFetch, which caps verbatim quotes at ~120 characters, so long quotes above are stitched from consecutive sub-120-char verbatim fragments (joined with '...'). Page-level screenshots of FF-45-2026 pages 1–2 were also read visually to confirm sections I–IV.

The DMF snapper-grouper link on the main page points at the proclamations index, not a specific document; the current recreational snapper-grouper proclamation in force is FF-45-2026 (Oct 28, 2026). FF-40-2026 (red snapper Oct 9–11, 2026) is superseded and retained only as a note.
FF-45-2026 III.G prints the gag season as May 1 – Aug 1, 2026 even though the proclamation issued Oct 28, 2026; treated as 'closed now' pending a 2027 proclamation.
Shark proclamation table cells for Bonnethead season and LCS/pelagic possession limit did not extract cleanly; values were taken from items E/F and footnotes rather than the table cells.

No current recreational proclamation re-opens Albemarle Sound striped bass (last action FF-17-2023 close) and the CSMA Tar-Pamlico/Neuse opening (FF-19-2026) ended April 30, 2026; both modeled as closed. Roanoke River striped bass season is set by WRC proclamation each spring and was not printed in the digest.

Mountain Trout county-specific waters lists (Counties A–M, N–Z, Other Trout Waters pages) were not enumerated water-by-water; only the class-level rules and the two Special Regulation waters printed on the general page were captured.
